topics.title: Getting a boat ready to spawn
topics.takeaway: Leaving the driver seat yourself shuts the engine off. A driver killed in the seat leaves it running.
topics.guidance: If a transport boat cannot be used to spawn, check its engine state. The new exit behavior removes that engine-related obstacle; it does not guarantee every spawn problem is solved.
topics.caution: Manual exit and driver death deliberately have different outcomes. Other missing-spawn problems remain separately tracked.

changes.summary: Manual driver exit now stops the engine automatically. Driver death keeps the engine running and can still deny spawning.

topics.title: Build basic defenses without Supplies
topics.takeaway: Level 1 defenses are free to construct. Save your Supply planning for upgrades.
topics.guidance: You can start basic construction before Supplies arrive. You now have three Barbed Wire placements, subject to the 50-per-side limit.
topics.caution: Free Level 1 construction does not make upgrades free or remove placement limits.

changes.summary: Level 1 construction stopped consuming Supplies; higher-level upgrades still require them.
Barbed Wire increased from two to three placements per Engineer, with a limit of 50 per side.

topics.title: Redeploy without the extra penalty
topics.takeaway: Choosing Redeploy no longer adds the extra ten-second punishment. The normal deployment wait remains.
topics.guidance: When planning a redeploy with your squad, account for the normal deployment timer rather than adding the former ten-second punishment.
topics.caution: This is a timer change, not instant spawning or a guarantee that a spawn point is available.

changes.summary: Removed the additional ten-second punishment for choosing Redeploy.

topics.title: Change shells without firing first
topics.takeaway: Select another shell type to unload the chambered round and load the new ammunition.
topics.guidance: Use the ammunition selection control when you need a different shell. You no longer have to fire the loaded round just to change types.
topics.caution: The notes establish unloading and reloading, not an instant ammunition swap.

changes.summary: Added shell unloading when changing ammunition types.

topics.title: Recheck your squad’s role options
topics.takeaway: Units now have two Medic slots and two Rifleman slots, replacing one and three respectively.
topics.guidance: Check the available roles when joining your unit. An occupied Medic slot no longer necessarily means that role is full.
topics.caution: Further Medic improvements are being discussed. Those proposals are not part of this released slot change.

changes.summary: Added a second Medic slot and reduced Rifleman slots from three to two.

topics.title: Check the new US loadout options
topics.takeaway: The Thompson joins selected US roles. M16A1 users can choose 30-round magazines with a Weight trade-off.
topics.guidance: Revisit your role’s loadout options. Compare magazine capacity with the Weight cost before changing your M16A1 setup; the 20-round option remains available.
topics.caution: More capacity is a choice, not proof of the strongest loadout. Thompson availability is limited to the roles listed below.

changes.summary: Added the M1A1 Thompson to selected US roles and an optional 30-round M16A1 configuration.

topics.title: Relearn boat handling and Fuel costs
topics.takeaway: Both boats handle differently. The US PBR has a larger speed advantage; the NVA boat now costs 250 Fuel.
topics.guidance: Allow for changed handling when returning to waterways. Commanders should budget 250 Fuel, rather than 200, for the NVA boat.
topics.caution: The notes describe relative improvements, not measured speed values or a guarantee of which boat wins an encounter.

changes.summary: Improved both boats’ handling and top speed, increased the US PBR’s relative speed and acceleration advantage, and raised the NVA boat’s Fuel cost by 50.

topics.title: Top up vehicle MG ammunition early
topics.takeaway: Tank coaxial MGs and boat Machine Gunner positions can be resupplied before they run completely dry.
topics.guidance: You no longer need to empty those guns before topping up at a resupply opportunity.
topics.caution: This change does not explicitly resolve the separately reported unequal resupply of the two boat bow guns.

changes.summary: Allowed ammunition top-ups before empty for tank coaxial MGs and boat Machine Gunner positions.

topics.title: Choose your Crouch / Melee layout
topics.takeaway: A Crouch / Melee swap is available across controller layouts.
topics.guidance: Check the new controller option if your current Crouch and Melee inputs feel awkward. Keep the existing layout if it already suits you.
topics.caution: This specific swap is live. Full controller remapping and a Radio / Equipment swap are not established by this release.

changes.summary: Released the Crouch / Melee input swap for controller layouts.

topics.title: Understand the Commander penalty change
topics.takeaway: Friendly deaths from Commander abilities no longer add that team-kill punishment to the Commander.
topics.guidance: Keep coordinating strike areas with your team. A changed punishment rule does not remove the need to protect teammates.
topics.caution: Personal weapons and other direct actions retain their usual punishment behavior. This is not a blanket removal of friendly fire or penalties.

changes.summary: Removed Commander team-kill punishment for friendly deaths caused by abilities such as Napalm, Artillery Strikes and Bombing Runs.
